Package jisa.experiment

Class Measurement<R>

  • java.lang.Object
    • jisa.experiment.Measurement<R>
  • Type Parameters:
    R - The class of the object used to store the data output of the measurement.
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    IVCurve
    public abstract class Measurement<R>
extends java.lang.Object
    Abstract class for encapsulating measurement routines. Allows one to define user-configurable parameters and instruments.

      • createData

        protected abstract R createData()
        Creates a new instance of whatever data structure this measurement is to use. This will be passed to all the measurement methods.

        For instance, one might want this method to return a new ResultTable.

        Returns:
        New measurement data structure

        protected abstract void main​(R data)
                      throws java.lang.Exception
        This method should contain the main logic of the measurement.

        data - The data structure to use for this run of the measurement.

      • after

        protected abstract void after​(R data)
                       throws java.lang.Exception
        This method is always called after a measurement has finished --- regardless of how it finished. That is, it will be called if it succeeded, ended in error, or was interrupted.
        Parameters:
        data - The data structure used for the measurement.
        Throws:
        java.lang.Exception

      • interrupted

        protected abstract void interrupted​(R data)
        This method is called if the run() method is interrupted. This will run before after() is called.

      • checkPoint

        public void checkPoint()
                throws java.lang.InterruptedException
        Defines a point in your routine at which it is safe to break if stop() is called. If neither this nor sleep() are called anywhere in run(), the calling stop() may have no effect.
        Throws:
        java.lang.InterruptedException - If stop() has been called.
